name: Letta
ontology_notes: Current product (letta-ai/letta-code) replaced MemGPT-style core/recall/archival tiers with MemFS, a git-versioned Markdown tree. Convention: system/persona.md and system/human.md always in the system prompt; files outside system/ are on-demand; skills live under skills/. The agent names paths. There is no typed relationship-state, lorebook, or OOC table. Historical V1 in letta-ai/letta archive branch used core/recall/archival; that server is retired. Docs still offer a Kawaii template as a personality demo.

ontology.evidence: concepts/memfs/index.md projects memory as Markdown paths. system/ is always-on identity and durable prefs; other files are reference. SDK memory labels become system/ files. This is a directory convention, not typed companion kinds.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: The agent edits MemFS with file tools and commits. /remember asks the agent to place a lesson. Dreaming subagents review conversations and update memory. The user can edit $MEMORY_DIR. No extractor loop that auto-writes every turn.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: system/ is injected every turn. The file tree is always in the system prompt; the agent reads other files with ordinary tools. MemFS has no vector index by default (optional memfs-search mod). Conversation compaction summarizes old messages. The agent can retrieve nothing from reference/ if it does not open those files.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Edits overwrite file contents. Git keeps history. Dreaming consolidates lessons. There is no valid_at/invalid_at. Two contradictory sentences in human.md can both remain until someone edits.
supersession.label: inferred

temporal.evidence: Git commits and conversation transcripts have timestamps. Conversations docs mention compaction and message search, not a last-Tuesday fact query. No validity windows on memories.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: persona vs human files split character and user. Shared memory repositories attach extra trees for cloud agents. Relationship state is not a type. Separate agents are separate MemFS trees (permissions memory guard).
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No policy to skip recalling a relevant memory for social reasons. File names in the always-on tree can themselves leak topics the agent then reads.
silence.label: inferred

poisoning.evidence: permissions/index.md denies tools that target another agent's memory directory even in unrestricted mode. The current agent can rewrite its own persona.md, including via dreaming. No trust tags on memory file contents. Poisoned chat can become durable identity if the agent writes it down.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: User or agent can delete or rewrite files. Git history can retain the old text until the operator prunes. Compaction drops exact wording from the active thread but message history remains searchable. No first-class forget-that API.
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: Every turn pays for system/ plus the file tree and recent conversation. Dreaming and /doctor are extra LLM jobs. There is no per-turn extract+embed tax unless the agent writes. Compaction is an LLM summary when the context fills. Token cost grows with system/ file size, not with session count in a vector store.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: self-hosting/index.md: local backend stores messages, memory, and provider connections on device with no Letta account. Apache-2.0 (brand assets excluded). Inference can be Ollama/LM Studio/llama.cpp. Cloud agents keep state at Letta.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: docs.letta.com/agent-sdk/mcp/index.md configures Letta as an MCP client (stdio/HTTP/SSE tools on the SDK host). Letta does not ship a memory MCP server that other clients attach to. ACP is a different protocol.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Closest of the four to a long-lived person: always-on persona/human files, agent-owned memory, local option, Kawaii template. Still a coding/coworker harness. MemFS does not type relationship vs lore vs OOC. Silence is absent. The agent can poison its own persona. Old core/recall/archival is retired, so do not design against MemGPT tiers.

published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Current MemFS docs and leaderboard.letta.com cover model/harness performance, not a published companion-memory QA bench. Historical MemGPT DMR 93.4% appears in Zep's 2025 paper as a baseline, not as a current Letta MemFS claim.

open_unknowns: Whether any V1 archival/recall APIs remain reachable in letta-code, or only the archive branch.
Whether dreaming prompts include a refusal to store jokes, hypotheticals, or jailbreaks as identity.
Whether local MemFS search (without the QMD mod) can recover a fact the agent did not put in system/ after many months.
